description: WhatRes scores a protein structure from its coordinates alone on two axes: apparent resolution (Å), the resolution at which an experimental structure would typically show the same local geometry, and realism (0 to 100), how experimental-like the geometry is, independent of resolution. It consists of whatres-features, a C++ program that computes the structural descriptors, and a Python package that applies the two trained models. Software accompanying the paper “Realism and resolution: how AI-predicted protein structures differ from experimental structures”.
